fusions.name: Ridgeline
fusions.desc: Raises a ridge of jagged stone 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slab Hurl
fusions.desc: Breaks a slab off the shield's stone face and throws it. It deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ground Holds Fast
fusions.desc: Plants the shield for 0.5 seconds, then the ground seizes every foot near it: every creature within 4 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flagstone Footing
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
